lines_of_business: HCSC plans (BCBSTX, IL, MT, NM, OK) per ALERT; Illinois mandates noted; Medicare referred to CMS
effective_or_revised: Policy Effective Date 10/15/2024; Policy End Date 12/31/2025
criteria_location: Coverage, pp.1-7: Table 1 (IF diagnosis THEN REVIEW) plus NOTES 1-12. Policy Guidelines: 'None.' Remaining ~85 pages evidence and references.

logic.top_level: pathways (table: one row per diagnosis, each with number of treatments before review)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Long investigational list 'and any diagnosis not previously listed as covered'; Note 11: 1 atm O2 without chamber is not HBO2.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Review thresholds per row: 'Approval of treatment or services beyond the number initially authorized requires review'. Request form 'for extension of treatment' items: 'Whether this is initial treatment or extension of treatment.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Acute carbon monoxide poisoning (intoxication) AND/OR acute smoke inhalation
Documentation must include at least two of the following: ... 1. Photo record(s), or 2. Consultation reports, or 3. ... or 4. Office records; AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 2-of-4 plus conjoined AND with wound-specific list; applies only 'when services are in excess of 1-month duration'

requirement_kinds.quote: Non-healing diabetic wounds ... who meet all the following three criteria
no measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy (See NOTE 12)
assessment of vascular status ... optimization of nutritional status, optimization of glucose control, debridement ... off-loading ... resolve any infection
Thermal burns, second- or third-degree burns involving 15% to 90% of total body surface and initiated within 24 hours of the burn injury
Shock, systolic blood pressure below 90 mm Hg ... Disorientation to coma ... Ischemic changes of the myocardium ... Ischemic gut
Venous stasis ulcer, only if venous surgery, local wound care, leg elevation, counterpressure support, and skin grafting fails
Documentation must include at least two of the following: Photo record(s) ... Consultation reports ...
Wagner classification system grade level ... Whether this is initial treatment or extension of treatment.

thresholds.quote: initiated within 24 hours of the burn injury
systolic blood pressure below 90 mm Hg

time_windows.quote: after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy
when services are in excess of 1-month duration
The average length of treatment is 2 to 4 weeks.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Codes only listed (99183; A4575, G0277); disclaimer says presence 'has no relevance for determination of benefit coverage'.

external_dependencies.quote: HCSC has created a form to facilitate review of requests for coverage of HBO2 therapy

Carefully check state regulations and/or the member contract.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Grade-4 = wet or dry gangrene in the toes or forefoot
Standard wound care in patients with diabetic wounds includes: assessment of a patient's vascular status ...

vague_terms.quote: For individual consideration of number of treatments
Compromised skin graft or flap, or for enhancement of healing in a selected problem wound

vague_terms.problem: covered for individual consideration with no criteria, in contrast to other payers

extraction_hazards: Table 1 two-column layout with bullets inside cells; row for diabetic wounds spans a page
Two rows ('Acute postoperative foot surgical treatment ...') have the review count blank in text
Notes 1-12 referenced out of order (Note 12 defined after Note 10, Note 11)
Policy end date 12/31/2025 printed though retrieved later; may be superseded
interesting_structures: Review-count column makes utilization checkpoint part of the criteria
Numeric burn TBSA and time window
Covers brown recluse spider bite, acute cerebral edema, decubitus ulcers, venous stasis ulcers
Staged documentation requirement kicks in after 1 month

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs
fit_to_tree.why: Mostly any-of rows, but the review-count column, notes, and 'individual consideration' rows are not criteria leaves; documentation rule is 2-of-4 conditional on duration.
